ModMetaData.name: AI Narrator
ModMetaData.author: Feng
ModMetaData.description: AI Narrator: an external large language model acts as your colony's narrative director. It decides on its own when to fire incidents, and can write multi-stage storylines in Lua on the spot (letters, choices, branches, timers). Since 0.6.0 the action library has grown to 42 actions: beyond narrative and map effects, the AI can change a pawn's thoughts and relationships, leave visible traces on the map (ruins, blood, animal herds), and set narrative objectives. The provider, model and call budget are all up to the player.
